items.transcript: Attention passengers. Flight VN218 to Da Nang will now depart from gate twelve instead of gate eight.
items.question: What changed?
items.feedback: The announcement replaces gate eight with gate twelve. The destination and flight number stay the same.

items.transcript: The museum closes at six, but the last guided tour begins at four thirty in the afternoon.
items.question: When does the last guided tour begin?
items.feedback: Four thirty is the tour start; six is the museum closing time. Listen for which event the question asks about.

items.transcript: Due to engineering work, trains to Oxford will leave from platform six until noon, then return to platform three.
items.question: Where do Oxford trains leave from before noon?
items.feedback: The temporary platform is six before noon. Platform three only applies after noon.

items.transcript: Passengers for flight LC218 should proceed to gate C12. Boarding begins at seven oh five, twenty minutes earlier than scheduled.
items.question: What should the passenger remember?
items.feedback: Remember both details together: C12 is the gate and seven oh five is the boarding time. Twenty minutes describes the change, not the time.

items.transcript: Your replacement flight leaves at seven forty and has one short connection in Singapore.
items.question: What is special about the replacement flight?
items.feedback: One short connection means a transfer in Singapore. It is not a direct flight.

items.transcript: Your checked bag will go directly to Hanoi. In Singapore, keep your hand luggage with you and follow the signs for transfers.
items.question: What should you carry during the connection?
items.feedback: The checked bag goes through to Hanoi. Only hand luggage stays with the passenger during the transfer.

items.transcript: The last green-line train leaves Central at eleven twenty. Passengers from the blue line should change at platform four.
items.question: Where should blue-line passengers change?
items.feedback: Platform four is the transfer point. Eleven twenty is the departure time, not the platform.

items.transcript: Because of maintenance, trains toward Riverside will skip East Market tonight.
items.question: Which stop will be skipped?
items.feedback: East Market is the skipped stop. Riverside is the direction of travel.

items.transcript: The express bus costs six pounds, while the local bus costs four. Both stop at the library, but only the local bus stops at the hospital.
items.question: Which bus should a hospital visitor take?
items.feedback: Only the local bus stops at the hospital. The cheaper fare alone is not the reason to choose it.

items.transcript: I work nearby, but I usually come to this cafe after class because it is quieter in the evening.
items.question: Why does the speaker come in the evening?
items.feedback: The speaker explicitly says the cafe is quieter in the evening. Working nearby does not explain the time of the visit.

items.transcript: I am really into badminton and films, but lately I have been learning photography too.
items.question: What new interest does the speaker mention?
items.feedback: Photography follows “lately I have been learning”. Badminton and films are existing interests.

items.transcript: I used to order coffee here, but it keeps me awake. Now I have mint tea unless they have run out; then I choose water.
items.question: What is the speaker's first choice now?
items.feedback: “Now” marks the change to mint tea. Water is the backup, and coffee is the old choice.

items.transcript: Saturday afternoon works for me, but I need to leave before six because I have dinner with my family.
items.question: What restriction does the speaker have?
options: They need to meet at six
items.feedback: The meeting can happen on Saturday, but leaving before six is a constraint. Six is not the meeting time.

items.transcript: Let's meet outside the cinema at three fifteen rather than at the cafe, because the cafe gets crowded.
items.question: Where will they meet?
items.feedback: “Rather than” replaces the cafe with the space outside the cinema.

items.transcript: If it rains, we will visit the gallery instead of the park. Either way, meet me at the station at ten.
items.question: What stays the same if it rains?
items.feedback: “Either way” keeps the station and ten o’clock fixed. Only the activity changes with the weather.

items.transcript: For this release, faster means the common search results should appear within one second, and exact title matches should rank first.
items.question: What is the response-time target?
items.feedback: Within one second is the performance target. Ranking exact matches first is a separate requirement.

items.transcript: If there are no exact matches, show up to five related suggestions rather than an empty state.
items.question: What should happen when there is no exact match?
items.correctAnswer: Show up to five related suggestions
options: Show up to five related suggestions
items.feedback: The instruction allows up to five suggestions instead of an empty state. It does not require exactly five every time.

items.transcript: Keep the current filters when a search returns no results. Show related suggestions below them, but do not change the filters automatically.
items.question: What must the application keep unchanged?
items.feedback: The current filters must remain unchanged. Suggestions are shown without silently changing the user’s selection.
